name: rsa-identity-basic
notes: Reader-conformance only: RSA-OAEP-SHA256 uses an internal random seed, so the encrypted DEK in the header is NOT byte-reproducible. A conforming reader MUST decrypt expected.bge with the private key and recover plaintext.bin exactly.
This expected.bge was produced by the reference implementation (bge CLI).
The key pair is a throwaway, published on purpose for verification only. NEVER use it for real data — see the filename.
Metadata in this file includes original filename/type/size and creation/modification timestamps.
